Riley: hey everyone, rookie question — i followed the k8s quickstart but `kubectl get pods -A` shows nothing in my namespace. I can see contexts for `redwood-dev` and `redwood-staging` in my kubeconfig.
Priya: welcome! first check which context you're using: `kubectl config current-context`. also run `kubectl config view --minify -o jsonpath='{..namespace}'` to see the default ns.
Riley: current-context is `redwood-dev`, default namespace blank. i set `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=riley-dev` but still `get pods -n riley-dev` empty.
Sam: did you run the onboarding script that creates the `riley-dev` namespace and RBAC? new hires need a RoleBinding for edit in their ns. i can provision it now if you want.
Riley: please! i tried the docs but i'm not sure if i have permission.
Priya: we try to avoid giving cluster-admin rights — we'll add a RoleBinding in the `riley-dev` ns that binds your OIDC user to the `edit` clusterrole. Sam, please create `kubectl create namespace riley-dev && kubectl create rolebinding riley-edit --clusterrole=edit --user=oidc:riley@example.com -n riley-dev`.
Sam: running it now. Also FYI if you need to test service port-forwarding for local dev, grant includes `pods/portforward`.
Sam: done — namespace and RoleBinding created. try `kubectl get pods -n riley-dev`.
Riley: pods show the quickstart deployment. Thanks! quick follow-up: i occasionally need to switch between my personal AWS SSO and company SSO — any best practice so contexts don't collide?
Priya: we recommend separate kubeconfig files per SSO session and a tiny switcher script. don't merge long-lived tokens into a single file. example approach: keep `~/.kube/config-work` and `~/.kube/config-personal` and export KUBECONFIG when switching.
Riley: noted. last q: who approves requests for ephemeral prod kubeconfig?
Priya: prod is handled by eng-sre. file the internal access form for ephemeral access; approvals are auditable and short-lived. avoid creating permanent ClusterRoleBindings.
eng-sre-bot: access-request `REQ-8192` created for user riley (ephemeral-prod) 4dd :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Riley: filing the form now — appreciate the help!
